          .font-driving { font-family: 'Bungee', cursive; }
          .font-buyer { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; }
          .font-sellercall { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -1px; }
          .app-view { display: none; }
          .app-view.active { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out; }
          @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
          }
        `}</style>

        <header className="max-w-xl mx-auto w-full flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
          <div onClick={() => switchView('home')} className="text-xs font-bold tracking-widest text-slate-400 uppercase cursor-pointer hover:text-slate-300 transition">
            Cool<span className="text-emerald-400">RealEstate</span>Tools.com
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div id="nav-action" style={{ display: 'none' }}>
              <button onClick={() => switchView('home')} className="text-xs font-bold bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-slate-700 transition">← Back to Menu</button>
            </div>
            {user ? (
              <button onClick={handleLogout} className="text-xs font-bold bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 hover:bg-rose-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition">
                Sign Out

// Reusable Email Magic Link Login Widget
function EmailLoginWidget() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')

  const handleSendMagicLink = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setMessage('')
    
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({ 
      email,
      options: { 
        shouldCreateUser: true,
        emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin
      }
    })

    if (error) {
      setMessage(error.message)
    } else {
      setSent(true)
      setMessage('Check your email and click the secure link to sign in!')
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-2xl max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="text-center mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Member Sign In</h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Enter your email for password-less magic link access.</p>
      </div>

      {!sent ? (
        <form onSubmit={handleSendMagicLink} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block mb-1">Email Address</label>
            <input 
              type="email"
              placeholder="name@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
            />
          </div>
          <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black py-4 rounded-xl transition shadow-lg">
            Send Magic Link →
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-center space-y-4 py-4">
          <div className="text-3xl">✨</div>
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">Magic link sent!</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Check your email inbox and click the link to log straight in.</p>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            onClick={() => { setSent(false); setEmail(''); setMessage(''); }}
            className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-white underline pt-2 block mx-auto"
          >
            Use a different email
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {message && (
        <p className={`text-xs text-center font-medium mt-4 ${message.includes('Check') || message.includes('sent') ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'}`}>
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
what is the supabase email limit

The email limit for Supabase depends on whether you are using their built-in email service or a custom SMTP provider:

Built-in Email Service (Default): Limited to 2 emails per hour project-wide. This service is intended strictly for local development and testing with your team (delivering only to pre-authorized addresses).

Custom SMTP Provider: If you connect a custom third-party email provider (such as Resend, SendGrid, Mailgun, or AWS SES) under your project's Auth settings, the default rate limit increases to 30 new users/emails per hour, but this can be adjusted and scaled depending on the provider and plan you choose.

can i send through my google workspace

Yes, you can route your Supabase emails through your Google Workspace account by connecting it as a Custom SMTP provider in your Supabase dashboard. This bypasses the strict 2-email-per-hour limit of Supabase's default testing service.

To set this up:

In your Supabase Dashboard, go to Authentication > Providers > Email.

Scroll down to SMTP Settings and toggle it Enabled.

Fill in your Google Workspace SMTP details:

Host: smtp.gmail.com

Port: 465 (for SSL) or 587 (for TLS)

Username: Your full Google Workspace email address.

Password: An App Password generated from your Google Account security settings (note: standard Google accounts and Workspace accounts require 2-Step Verification enabled to generate an App Password for third-party apps).

Sender Email & Name: Your professional domain email address.

am i limited to 30 per hour then?

No, you are not permanently stuck at 30 per hour once you hook up custom SMTP.

While Supabase sets a default baseline of 30 emails per hour when you first enable a custom SMTP provider as a safety measure, you can easily change that number to match your app's actual needs.

Once your custom SMTP is active, you can adjust your threshold by going to Authentication > Rate Limits in your Supabase dashboard and updating the hourly email sending cap.

However, keep in mind that Google Workspace itself has strict outgoing sending limits to prevent spam:

Standard Google Workspace accounts typically limit you to around 2,000 emails per rolling 24-hour period (though brand new accounts or trial workspaces often start much lower).

If you exceed Google Workspace's internal limits, Google will temporarily block outgoing mail from your account, regardless of what you set inside Supabase.

If your tool suite grows to the point where you are sending hundreds or thousands of magic links a day, it is usually best to transition from Google Workspace to a dedicated transactional email API service (like Resend, SendGrid, or AWS SES) to avoid getting your workspace domain flagged or rate-limited by Google.

how do i setup resend for this

Setting up Resend as your custom email provider for Supabase is fast, highly reliable, and gives you a generous free tier (3,000 emails per month) without hitting Google Workspace's daily sending restrictions.

Here is how to set it up step-by-step:

Step 1: Create a Resend Account & Domain
Go to Resend.com and create a free account.

Once logged in, go to the Domains tab on the left and click Add Domain.

Enter your domain (e.g., coolrealestatetools.com).

Resend will provide you with a set of DNS records (TXT and CNAME records). Go to your domain registrar (where you bought your domain, like GoDaddy, Namecheap, Cloudflare, etc.) and add those records.

Back in Resend, click Verify Domain. Once verified, your domain is ready to send emails.

Step 2: Generate an API Key
In your Resend dashboard, navigate to API Keys.

Click Create API Key.

Give it a name (e.g., Supabase Auth), select Full Access, and click create.

Copy the API key immediately and save it somewhere secure (you won't be able to view it again).

Step 3: Configure Custom SMTP in Supabase
Resend allows you to connect via standard SMTP using the API key you just generated.

Go to your Supabase Dashboard and navigate to Authentication > Providers > Email.

Scroll down to the SMTP Settings section and toggle it Enabled.

Fill out the SMTP configuration fields using Resend's credentials:

Host: smtp.resend.com

Port: 465 (or 587)

Username: resend

Password: [Paste your Resend API Key here]

Sender Email: auth@yourdomain.com (must match your verified domain in Resend)

Sender Name: Cool Real Estate Tools

Click Save.

Step 4: Update Supabase Rate Limits (Optional)
Because Resend is built specifically for transactional application emails, you won't be bound by Google's strict limits.

In your Supabase Dashboard, go to Authentication > Rate Limits.

Update the Email Rate Limit to match your expected volume so you never get throttled as your user base grows.

// Reusable Email Magic Link Login Widget
function EmailLoginWidget() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')

  const handleSendMagicLink = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setMessage('')
    
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({

            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block mb-1">Email Address</label>

            />

          <div className="text-3xl">✨</div>
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400 whitespace-pre-line">{message}</p>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            onClick={() => { setSent(false); setEmail(''); setMessage(''); }}
            className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-white underline pt-4 block mx-auto"
          >
            Use a different email
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {message && !sent && (
        <p className="text-xs text-center font-medium mt-4 text-rose-400">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

Let's now save their profile info in the database

To save the user's profile information in the database, we need to set up a table in Supabase that links directly to their authenticated user ID, and then wire up the frontend "Make My Profile" view to save the inputs.

Here are the step-by-step instructions to get this working:

Step 1: Create the profiles Table in Supabase
Go to your Supabase Dashboard and open your project.

Navigate to the SQL Editor on the left sidebar and click New Query.

Paste and run the following SQL snippet to create a profiles table with Row Level Security (RLS) enabled so users can only read and edit their own data:

SQL
create table profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users on delete cascade primary key,
  full_name text,
  brokerage text,
  phone text,
  headshot_url text,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- Enable Row Level Security
alter table profiles enable row level security;

-- Policy: Users can view their own profile
create policy "Users can view own profile" 
  on profiles for select 
  using (auth.uid() = id);

-- Policy: Users can insert their own profile
create policy "Users can insert own profile" 
  on profiles for insert 
  with check (auth.uid() = id);

-- Policy: Users can update their own profile
create policy "Users can update own profile" 
  on profiles for update 
  using (auth.uid() = id);
Step 2: Update Your Profile View in app/page.jsx
Replace your existing view-profile form and the save button logic in app/page.jsx with stateful React handlers that fetch existing data on load and save changes directly to Supabase.

Update your app/page.jsx component to include profile state loading and saving:

JavaScript
'use client'
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { supabase } from '@/utils/supabase'

export default function HomePage() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState({
    full_name: '',
    brokerage: '',
    phone: '',
    headshot_url: ''
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
      const currentUser = session?.user || null
      setUser(currentUser)

      if (currentUser) {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', currentUser.id)
          .single()
        
        if (data) {
          setProfile({
            full_name: data.full_name || '',
            brokerage: data.brokerage || '',
            phone: data.phone || '',
            headshot_url: data.headshot_url || ''
          })
        }
      }
    }
    loadData()
    switchView('home')
  }, [])

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    window.location.reload()
  }

  const showCustomModal = (msg) => {
    const modalMsg = document.getElementById('modal-message')
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modalMsg && modal) {
      modalMsg.innerText = msg
      modal.classList.remove('hidden')
    }
  }

  const closeCustomModal = () => {
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modal) {
      modal.classList.add('hidden')
    }
  }

  const switchView = (viewId) => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.app-view').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('active')
    })
    
    const targetView = document.getElementById('view-' + viewId)
    if(targetView) {
      targetView.classList.add('active')
    }
    
    const navAction = document.getElementById('nav-action')
    if(navAction) {
      navAction.style.display = viewId === 'home' ? 'none' : 'block'
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }

  const calculateNet = () => {
    const priceInput = document.getElementById('net-price')
    const payoffInput = document.getElementById('net-payoff')
    const commInput = document.getElementById('net-comm')
    const outputEl = document.getElementById('net-output')

    if (!priceInput || !payoffInput || !commInput || !outputEl) return

    const price = parseFloat(priceInput.value) || 0
    const payoff = parseFloat(payoffInput.value) || 0
    const commRate = parseFloat(commInput.value) || 0
    const commission = price * (commRate / 100)
    const closingCosts = price * 0.015
    
    const net = price - payoff - commission - closingCosts
    outputEl.innerText = '$' + (net > 0 ? net.toLocaleString('en-US', {maximumFractionDigits: 0}) : 0)
  }

  const submitOpenHouse = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  const resetOpenHouse = () => {
    document.getElementById('oh-name').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-phone').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  const saveProfile = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!user) {
      showCustomModal('Please sign in first to save your profile settings!')
      switchView('signin')
      return
    }

    const updates = {
      id: user.id,
      ...profile,
      updated_at: new Date(),
    }

    const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').upsert(updates)

    if (error) {
      showCustomModal('Error saving profile: ' + error.message)
    } else {
      showCustomModal('Profile saved! Your micro-apps are now branded.')
      switchView('home')
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between p-4 md:p-8 bg-[#0f172a] text-[#f8fafc] font-['Inter',sans-serif]">
        
        <style jsx global>{`
          .font-money { font-family: 'VT323', monospace; }
          .font-openhouse { font-family: 'Righteous', cursive; }
          .font-seller { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-style: italic; }
          .font-driving { font-family: 'Bungee', cursive; }
          .font-buyer { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; }
          .font-sellercall { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -1px; }
          .app-view { display: none; }
          .app-view.active { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out; }
          @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
          }
        `}</style>

        <header className="max-w-xl mx-auto w-full flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
          <div onClick={() => switchView('home')} className="text-xs font-bold tracking-widest text-slate-400 uppercase cursor-pointer hover:text-slate-300 transition">
            Cool<span className="text-emerald-400">RealEstate</span>Tools.com
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div id="nav-action" style={{ display: 'none' }}>
              <button onClick={() => switchView('home')} className="text-xs font-bold bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-slate-700 transition">← Back to Menu</button>
            </div>
            {user ? (
              <button onClick={handleLogout} className="text-xs font-bold bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 hover:bg-rose-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition">
                Sign Out
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button onClick={() => switchView('signin')} className="text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition">
                Sign In
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Main Container */}
        <main className="max-w-xl mx-auto w-full flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center">

          {/* VIEW: HOME */}
          <div id="view-home" className="app-view active space-y-4">
            <div className="text-center mb-6">
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Tap a Tool. Get to Work.</h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">$29 a month. All tools included. No corporate bloat.</p>
            </div>

            {/* Profile Button */}
            <div onClick={() => switchView('profile')} className="group relative bg-fuchsia-600 hover:bg-fuchsia-500 text-white p-6 rounded-3xl transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.01] shadow-xl flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[120px] overflow-hidden cursor-pointer">
              <div className="absolute right-6 top-6 text-3xl opacity-20 group-hover:opacity-40 transition transform group-hover:scale-110">👤</div>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold tracking-wider uppercase opacity-70">Brand your tools</span>

// Reusable Email Magic Link Login Widget
function EmailLoginWidget() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')

  const handleSendMagicLink = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setMessage('')
    
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({ 
      email,
      options: { 
        shouldCreateUser: true,
        emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin
      }
    })

    if (error) {
      setMessage(error.message)
    } else {
      setSent(true)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-2xl max-w-md mx-auto">
      {!sent ? (
        <form onSubmit={handleSendMagicLink} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block mb-1">Email Address</label>
            <input 
              type="email"
              placeholder="name@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
            />
          </div>
          <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black py-4 rounded-xl transition shadow-lg">
            Send Magic Link →
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-center space-y-3 py-4">
          <div className="text-4xl mb-2">✨</div>
          <h3 className="font-money text-3xl text-emerald-400 tracking-wide">Magic Link Sent!</h3>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">Check your email inbox and click the link to log straight in.</p>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            onClick={() => { setSent(false); setEmail(''); setMessage(''); }}
            className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-white underline pt-4 block mx-auto"
          >
            Use a different email
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {message && !sent && (
        <p className="text-xs text-center font-medium mt-4 text-rose-400">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
1) let's add email to the profile inputs. 2) let's move the profile picture and brokerage logo into a step 2 after the initial profile data is stored. That way we don't lose the capture of the basic data. If the user is not logged in or does not have an account, let's assume them filling out the profile data will act as their login.



once they submit the first set of data should we force them to go to their email to verify the account. Then when they do, we can bring them straight back into the optional step 2 of their profile, which would be to upload their profile picture and brokerage logo. I want to store the images instead of using links. The entire process should be super easy so that anyone could follow it without insturction.

To build a frictionless onboarding and profile setup flow that captures basic information first (acting as an account creation/login) before prompting for email verification and a second step for image uploads, we need to handle a few key things:

Storage Bucket Setup: Create a secure storage bucket in Supabase for user images (headshots and logos).

Database & UI Flow: Split the profile form into Step 1 (Basic Data & Email) and Step 2 (Image Uploads), seamlessly triggering the Supabase magic link signup/login upon the first submission.

Step 1: Create a Supabase Storage Bucket for Images
Go to your Supabase Dashboard and click on Storage in the left sidebar.

Click Create a new bucket.

Name the bucket profiles and make it Public (so profile pictures and logos can be rendered publicly via URLs across your tools). Click Create bucket.

(Optional Policy) Set up a RLS policy on storage objects allowing authenticated users to upload and update files inside their own folder/paths.

Step 2: Updated app/page.jsx with Multi-Step Profile & Image Storage
Replace your app/page.jsx file with the code below. This version adds an email input to Step 1, triggers the magic link login seamlessly, and routes them to a Step 2 image upload view after they authenticate.

JavaScript
'use client'
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { supabase } from '@/utils/supabase'

export default function HomePage() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)
  const [profileStep, setProfileStep] = useState(1) // 1 = text data, 2 = image uploads
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState({
    email: '',
    full_name: '',
    brokerage: '',
    phone: '',
    headshot_url: '',
    logo_url: ''
  })
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
      const currentUser = session?.user || null
      setUser(currentUser)

      if (currentUser) {
        setProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, email: currentUser.email || '' }))
        const { data } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', currentUser.id)
          .single()
        
        if (data) {
          setProfile({
            email: currentUser.email || '',
            full_name: data.full_name || '',
            brokerage: data.brokerage || '',
            phone: data.phone || '',
            headshot_url: data.headshot_url || '',
            logo_url: data.logo_url || ''
          })
        }
      }
    }
    loadData()
    switchView('home')
  }, [])

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    window.location.reload()
  }

  const showCustomModal = (msg) => {
    const modalMsg = document.getElementById('modal-message')
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modalMsg && modal) {
      modalMsg.innerText = msg
      modal.classList.remove('hidden')
    }
  }

  const closeCustomModal = () => {
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modal) {
      modal.classList.add('hidden')
    }
  }

  const switchView = (viewId) => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.app-view').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('active')
    })
    
    const targetView = document.getElementById('view-' + viewId)
    if(targetView) {
      targetView.classList.add('active')
    }
    
    const navAction = document.getElementById('nav-action')
    if(navAction) {
      navAction.style.display = viewId === 'home' ? 'none' : 'block'
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }

  const calculateNet = () => {
    const priceInput = document.getElementById('net-price')
    const payoffInput = document.getElementById('net-payoff')
    const commInput = document.getElementById('net-comm')
    const outputEl = document.getElementById('net-output')

    if (!priceInput || !payoffInput || !commInput || !outputEl) return

    const price = parseFloat(priceInput.value) || 0
    const payoff = parseFloat(payoffInput.value) || 0
    const commRate = parseFloat(commInput.value) || 0
    const commission = price * (commRate / 100)
    const closingCosts = price * 0.015
    
    const net = price - payoff - commission - closingCosts
    outputEl.innerText = '$' + (net > 0 ? net.toLocaleString('en-US', {maximumFractionDigits: 0}) : 0)
  }

  const submitOpenHouse = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  const resetOpenHouse = () => {
    document.getElementById('oh-name').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-phone').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  // Step 1: Save basic data and trigger Magic Link verification
  const handleStep1Submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    if (!user) {
      // Trigger Magic Link authentication if not logged in
      const { error: authError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({
        email: profile.email,
        options: { 
          shouldCreateUser: true,
          emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin
        }
      })

      if (authError) {
        showCustomModal('Error sending verification link: ' + authError.message)
        return
      }

      showCustomModal('Magic link sent! Check your email to verify your account and proceed to Step 2.')
      return
    }

    // If already logged in, update data and advance to Step 2
    const updates = {
      id: user.id,
      full_name: profile.full_name,
      brokerage: profile.brokerage,
      phone: profile.phone,
      updated_at: new Date(),
    }

    const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').upsert(updates)

    if (error) {
      showCustomModal('Error saving profile: ' + error.message)
    } else {
      setProfileStep(2)
      showCustomModal('Basic info saved! Now add your images.')
    }
  }

  // Handle direct file uploads to Supabase Storage bucket
  const handleImageUpload = async (e, fieldName) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0]
    if (!file || !user) return

    setUploading(true)
    const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop()
    const fileName = `${user.id}/${fieldName}-${Math.random()}.${fileExt}`

    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
      .from('profiles')
      .upload(fileName, file, { upsert: true })

    if (uploadError) {
      showCustomModal('Upload failed: ' + uploadError.message)
      setUploading(false)
      return
    }

    // Get public URL
    const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage
      .from('profiles')
      .getPublicUrl(fileName)

    const updatedProfile = { ...profile, [fieldName]: publicUrl }
    setProfile(updatedProfile)

    // Save URL to database immediately
    await supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
      id: user.id,
      [fieldName]: publicUrl,
      updated_at: new Date()
    })

    setUploading(false)
    showCustomModal('Image uploaded successfully!')
  }

  return (
    <>

          .font-driving { font-family: 'Bungee', cursive; }
          .font-buyer { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; }
          .font-sellercall { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -1px; }
          .app-view { display: none; }
          .app-view.active { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out; }
          @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
          }
        `}</style>

        <header className="max-w-xl mx-auto w-full flex justify-between items-center mb-6">

            Cool<span className="text-emerald-400">RealEstate</span>Tools.com
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div id="nav-action" style={{ display: 'none' }}>
              <button onClick={() => switchView('home')} className="text-xs font-bold bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-slate-700 transition">← Back to Menu</button>
            </div>
            {user ? (
              <button onClick={handleLogout} className="text-xs font-bold bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 hover:bg-rose-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition">
                Sign Out
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button onClick={() => switchView('signin')} className="text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition">
                Sign In
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Main Container */}
        <main className="max-w-xl mx-auto w-full flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center">

          {/* VIEW: HOME */}
          <div id="view-home" className="app-view active space-y-4">
            <div className="text-center mb-6">
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Tap a Tool. Get to Work.</h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">$29 a month. All tools included. No corporate bloat.</p>
            </div>

            <div onClick={() => switchView('profile')} className="group relative bg-fuchsia-600 hover:bg-fuchsia-500 text-white p-6 rounded-3xl transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.01] shadow-xl flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[120px] overflow-hidden cursor-pointer">

// Reusable Email Magic Link Login Widget
function EmailLoginWidget() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')

  const handleSendMagicLink = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setMessage('')
    
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({ 
      email,
      options: { 
        shouldCreateUser: true,
        emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin
      }
    })

    if (error) {
      setMessage(error.message)
    } else {
      setSent(true)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-2xl max-w-md mx-auto">
      {!sent ? (
        <form onSubmit={handleSendMagicLink} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block mb-1">Email Address</label>
            <input 
              type="email"
              placeholder="name@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
            />
          </div>
          <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black py-4 rounded-xl transition shadow-lg">
            Send Magic Link →
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-center space-y-3 py-4">
          <div className="text-4xl mb-2">✨</div>
          <h3 className="font-money text-3xl text-emerald-400 tracking-wide">Magic Link Sent!</h3>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">Check your email inbox and click the link to log straight in.</p>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            onClick={() => { setSent(false); setEmail(''); setMessage(''); }}
            className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-white underline pt-4 block mx-auto"
          >
            Use a different email
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {message && !sent && (
        <p className="text-xs text-center font-medium mt-4 text-rose-400">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
what file size limit should i add. also, what image types should i alllow

For professional profile pictures and brokerage logos, here are the recommended file size limits and image types:

1. File Size Limit
Recommended Limit: 2 MB to 5 MB (e.g., 2 * 1024 * 1024 bytes).

Why: High-resolution headshots or vector-based logos can sometimes be large, but anything over 5 MB is unnecessary for web avatars and will slow down upload speeds and page rendering.

2. Allowed Image Types
Recommended Formats: JPEG (.jpg, .jpeg), PNG (.png), and WebP (.webp).

Why:

PNG is essential for logos because it supports transparency (transparent backgrounds).

JPEG / WebP are ideal for professional headshots due to their small file size and high compression quality.

(Optional) Avoid raw formats (.raw, .tiff) or oversized SVGs without dimensions, as they can break layout containers.

How to Implement This Check in app/page.jsx
You can validate the file size and type right inside your handleImageUpload function before sending it to Supabase Storage:

JavaScript
const handleImageUpload = async (e, fieldName) => {
  const file = e.target.files[0]
  if (!file || !user) return

  // 1. Validate File Size (Max 5MB)
  const maxSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024
  if (file.size > maxSize) {
    showCustomModal('File size is too large. Please upload an image under 5MB.')
    return
  }

  // 2. Validate File Type
  const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']
  if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
    showCustomModal('Invalid file type. Please upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.')
    return
  }

  setUploading(true)
  const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop()
  const fileName = `${user.id}/${fieldName}-${Math.random()}.${fileExt}`

  const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
    .from('profiles')
    .upload(fileName, file, { upsert: true })

  if (uploadError) {
    showCustomModal('Upload failed: ' + uploadError.message)
    setUploading(false)
    return
  }

  const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage
    .from('profiles')
    .getPublicUrl(fileName)

  const updatedProfile = { ...profile, [fieldName]: publicUrl }
  setProfile(updatedProfile)

  await supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
    id: user.id,
    [fieldName]: publicUrl,
    updated_at: new Date()
  })

  setUploading(false)
  showCustomModal('Image uploaded successfully!')
}
Update the SQL Query to modify the Supabase

To support storing your images directly in a storage bucket and keeping track of both your headshot and brokerage logo URLs, run the following updated SQL query in your Supabase SQL Editor.

This query safely updates your profiles table to include a logo_url column alongside your existing fields.

SQL
-- 1. Update the public profiles table to ensure logo_url exists alongside headshot_url
create table if not exists public.profiles (
  id uuid references auth.users on delete cascade primary key,
  full_name text,
  brokerage text,
  phone text,
  headshot_url text,
  logo_url text,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now()) not null
);

-- If the table already existed without logo_url, this safe-guards adding it:
alter table public.profiles add column if not exists logo_url text;

-- 2. Enable Row Level Security (RLS)
alter table public.profiles enable row level security;

-- 3. Re-apply security policies safely (drops old ones if they exist first to avoid errors)
drop policy if exists "Users can view own profile" on profiles;
drop policy if exists "Users can insert own profile" on profiles;
drop policy if exists "Users can update own profile" on profiles;

create policy "Users can view own profile" 
  on profiles for select 
  using (auth.uid() = id);

create policy "Users can insert own profile" 
  on profiles for insert 
  with check (auth.uid() = id);

create policy "Users can update own profile" 
  on profiles for update 
  using (auth.uid() = id);
Next Steps in Supabase Dashboard:
Make sure you created a public storage bucket named profiles under Storage in your Supabase dashboard.

(Optional Storage Policy) If you want to make sure authenticated users can securely upload files into their designated folders within that bucket via RLS, add an insert policy on storage.objects like this:

SQL
create policy "Authenticated users can upload profile assets"
on storage.objects for insert
to authenticated
with check ( bucket_id = 'profiles' );

'use client'
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { supabase } from '@/utils/supabase'

export default function HomePage() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)
  const [profileStep, setProfileStep] = useState(1) // 1 = text data, 2 = image uploads
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState({
    full_name: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    brokerage: '',
    headshot_url: '',
    logo_url: ''
  })
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
      const currentUser = session?.user || null
      setUser(currentUser)

      if (currentUser) {
        const { data } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', currentUser.id)
          .single()
        
        if (data) {
          setProfile({
            full_name: data.full_name || '',
            email: data.email || currentUser.email || '',
            phone: data.phone || '',
            brokerage: data.brokerage || '',
            headshot_url: data.headshot_url || '',
            logo_url: data.logo_url || ''
          })
        } else {
          setProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, email: currentUser.email || '' }))
        }
      }
    }
    loadData()
    switchView('home')
  }, [])

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    window.location.reload()
  }

  const showCustomModal = (msg) => {
    const modalMsg = document.getElementById('modal-message')
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modalMsg && modal) {
      modalMsg.innerText = msg
      modal.classList.remove('hidden')
    }
  }

  const closeCustomModal = () => {
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modal) {
      modal.classList.add('hidden')
    }
  }

  const switchView = (viewId) => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.app-view').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('active')
    })
    
    const targetView = document.getElementById('view-' + viewId)
    if(targetView) {
      targetView.classList.add('active')
    }
    
    const navAction = document.getElementById('nav-action')
    if(navAction) {
      navAction.style.display = viewId === 'home' ? 'none' : 'block'
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }

  const calculateNet = () => {
    const priceInput = document.getElementById('net-price')
    const payoffInput = document.getElementById('net-payoff')
    const commInput = document.getElementById('net-comm')
    const outputEl = document.getElementById('net-output')

    if (!priceInput || !payoffInput || !commInput || !outputEl) return

    const price = parseFloat(priceInput.value) || 0
    const payoff = parseFloat(payoffInput.value) || 0
    const commRate = parseFloat(commInput.value) || 0
    const commission = price * (commRate / 100)
    const closingCosts = price * 0.015
    
    const net = price - payoff - commission - closingCosts
    outputEl.innerText = '$' + (net > 0 ? net.toLocaleString('en-US', {maximumFractionDigits: 0}) : 0)
  }

  const submitOpenHouse = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  const resetOpenHouse = () => {
    document.getElementById('oh-name').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-phone').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  // Step 1: Save basic data (Full Name, Email, Phone, Brokerage) and trigger Magic Link verification if new
  const handleStep1Submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    if (!user) {
      // Trigger Magic Link authentication if not logged in
      const { error: authError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({
        email: profile.email,
        options: { 
          shouldCreateUser: true,
          emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin
        }
      })

      if (authError) {
        showCustomModal('Error sending verification link: ' + authError.message)
        return
      }

      showCustomModal('Magic link sent! Check your email to verify your account and proceed to Step 2.')
      return
    }

    // If already logged in, update data and advance to Step 2
    const updates = {
      id: user.id,
      full_name: profile.full_name,
      email: profile.email,
      phone: profile.phone,
      brokerage: profile.brokerage,
      updated_at: new Date(),
    }

    const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').upsert(updates)

    if (error) {
      showCustomModal('Error saving profile: ' + error.message)
    } else {
      setProfileStep(2)
      showCustomModal('Basic info saved! Now add your images.')
    }
  }

  // Handle direct file uploads with strict size and format validation
  const handleImageUpload = async (e, fieldName) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0]
    if (!file || !user) return

    // 1. Validate File Size (Max 5MB)
    const maxSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024
    if (file.size > maxSize) {
      showCustomModal('File size is too large. Please upload an image under 5MB.')
      return
    }

    // 2. Validate File Type (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      showCustomModal('Invalid file type. Please upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.')
      return
    }

    setUploading(true)
    const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop()
    const fileName = `${user.id}/${fieldName}-${Math.random()}.${fileExt}`

    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
      .from('profiles')
      .upload(fileName, file, { upsert: true })

    if (uploadError) {
      showCustomModal('Upload failed: ' + uploadError.message)
      setUploading(false)
      return
    }

    // Get public URL
    const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage
      .from('profiles')
      .getPublicUrl(fileName)

    const updatedProfile = { ...profile, [fieldName]: publicUrl }
    setProfile(updatedProfile)

    // Save URL to database immediately
    await supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
      id: user.id,
      [fieldName]: publicUrl,
      updated_at: new Date()
    })

    setUploading(false)
    showCustomModal('Image uploaded successfully!')
  }

                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block mb-1">Brokerage</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    placeholder="e.g. Luxury Real Estate Inc." 
                    value={profile.brokerage}

                    className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-fuchsia-500 transition-colors" 
                  />
                </div>
                <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-fuchsia-500 hover:from-purple-400 hover:to-fuchsia-400 text-white font-black py-4 rounded-xl transition shadow-lg mt-4">
                  {user ? 'Save & Continue to Step 2 →' : 'Continue & Verify Email →'}
                </button>
              </form>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block">Professional Headshot</label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    {profile.headshot_url && (
                      <img src={profile.headshot_url} alt="Headshot" className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full object-cover border border-slate-700" />
                    )}
                    <input 
                      type="file" 
                      accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                      onChange={(e) => handleImageUpload(e, 'headshot_url')}
                      className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs text-slate-300 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-xs file:font-bold file:bg-fuchsia-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-fuchsia-500 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block">Brokerage Logo</label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    {profile.logo_url && (
                      <img src={profile.logo_url} alt="Logo" className="w-16 h-16 rounded-lg object-contain bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 p-1" />
                    )}
                    <input 
                      type="file" 
                      accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                      onChange={(e) => handleImageUpload(e, 'logo_url')}
                      className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs text-slate-300 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-xs file:font-bold file:bg-fuchsia-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-fuchsia-500 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {uploading && <p className="text-xs text-center text-fuchsia-400 font-bold animate-pulse">Uploading image (Max 5MB)...</p>}

                <button 
                  onClick={() => { showCustomModal('Profile fully updated!'); switchView('home'); }} 
                  className="w-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black py-4 rounded-xl transition shadow-lg mt-4"
                >
                  ✓ Finish & Return to Dashboard
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

        </main>

        {/* Global Footer */}
        <footer className="max-w-xl mx-auto w-full text-center pt-8 pb-2 text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
          coolrealestatetools.com • $29/mo
        </footer>

        {/* Custom Safe Modal Box */}
        <div id="custom-modal" className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 hidden">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full text-center space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="text-3xl">✨</div>
            <p id="modal-message" className="text-sm font-bold text-white"></p>
            <button onClick={closeCustomModal} className="w-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-xl transition">Got it</button>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </>
  )
}

// Reusable Email Magic Link Login Widget
function EmailLoginWidget() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')

  const handleSendMagicLink = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setMessage('')
    
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({ 
      email,
      options: { 
        shouldCreateUser: true,
        emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin
      }
    })

    if (error) {
      setMessage(error.message)
    } else {
      setSent(true)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-2xl max-w-md mx-auto">
      {!sent ? (
        <form onSubmit={handleSendMagicLink} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block mb-1">Email Address</label>
            <input 
              type="email"
              placeholder="name@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
            />
          </div>
          <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black py-4 rounded-xl transition shadow-lg">
            Send Magic Link →
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-center space-y-3 py-4">
          <div className="text-4xl mb-2">✨</div>
          <h3 className="font-money text-3xl text-emerald-400 tracking-wide">Magic Link Sent!</h3>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">Check your email inbox and click the link to log straight in.</p>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            onClick={() => { setSent(false); setEmail(''); setMessage(''); }}
            className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-white underline pt-4 block mx-auto"
          >
            Use a different email
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {message && !sent && (
        <p className="text-xs text-center font-medium mt-4 text-rose-400">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
Upload failed: new row violates row-level security policy

This error happens because Supabase Storage has Row Level Security (RLS) enabled by default, blocking anonymous or unauthenticated file uploads into the storage bucket.

To fix this, you need to add storage policies in your Supabase dashboard that allow authenticated users to upload files to the profiles bucket.

How to Fix It (Supabase Dashboard)
Open your Supabase Dashboard and go to Storage on the left menu.

Click on your profiles bucket.

Click on the Policies tab at the top.

Click New Policy > For full customization (or create a policy from scratch).

Add the following policies:

Policy 1: Allow authenticated users to upload files
Policy Name: Allow authenticated uploads

Allowed Operation: INSERT

Target roles: authenticated

WITH CHECK expression:

SQL
bucket_id = 'profiles'
Policy 2: Allow authenticated users to update/overwrite their own files
Policy Name: Allow authenticated updates

Allowed Operation: UPDATE

Target roles: authenticated

USING expression:

SQL
bucket_id = 'profiles'
Policy 3: Allow public viewing of profile images
Policy Name: Allow public viewing

Allowed Operation: SELECT

Target roles: anon, authenticated

USING expression:

SQL
bucket_id = 'profiles'
Alternatively, you can run this SQL query directly in your Supabase SQL Editor to create these storage security policies instantly:

SQL
-- Allow authenticated users to upload files to the profiles bucket
create policy "Authenticated users can upload profiles"
  on storage.objects for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (bucket_id = 'profiles');

-- Allow authenticated users to update files in the profiles bucket
create policy "Authenticated users can update profiles"
  on storage.objects for update
  to authenticated
  using (bucket_id = 'profiles');

-- Allow public access to view files in the profiles bucket
create policy "Public can view profiles"
  on storage.objects for select
  to public
  using (bucket_id = 'profiles');
1) Let's design 5 different looks for how agents information will appear on PDFs. The agent can scroll through and set their default look. The design elements will be used for anything they output from the app. 2) Let's add more fields to the net sheet. make it comprehensive, but again very simple for agents to understand. 3) let's design the net sheet PDF.

JavaScript
'use client'
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { supabase } from '@/utils/supabase'

export default function HomePage() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)
  const [profileStep, setProfileStep] = useState(1) 
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState({
    full_name: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    brokerage: '',
    headshot_url: '',
    logo_url: '',
    pdf_look: 'modern' // default look
  })
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false)

  // Comprehensive Net Sheet State
  const [netData, setNetData] = useState({
    salePrice: 750000,
    mortgagePayoff: 400000,
    secondMortgage: 0,
    propertyTaxesOwed: 2500,
    hoaFeesDue: 300,
    agentCommissionPct: 5,
    transferTaxPct: 0.75,
    titleEscrowFee: 1500,
    attorneyFee: 750,
    homeWarranty: 600,
    repairsCredit: 0
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
      const currentUser = session?.user || null
      setUser(currentUser)

      if (currentUser) {
        const { data } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', currentUser.id)
          .single()
        
        if (data) {
          setProfile({
            full_name: data.full_name || '',
            email: data.email || currentUser.email || '',
            phone: data.phone || '',
            brokerage: data.brokerage || '',
            headshot_url: data.headshot_url || '',
            logo_url: data.logo_url || '',
            pdf_look: data.pdf_look || 'modern'
          })
        } else {
          setProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, email: currentUser.email || '' }))
        }
      }
    }
    loadData()
    switchView('home')
  }, [])

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    window.location.reload()
  }

  const showCustomModal = (msg) => {
    const modalMsg = document.getElementById('modal-message')
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modalMsg && modal) {
      modalMsg.innerText = msg
      modal.classList.remove('hidden')
    }
  }

  const closeCustomModal = () => {
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modal) {
      modal.classList.add('hidden')
    }
  }

  const switchView = (viewId) => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.app-view').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('active')
    })
    
    const targetView = document.getElementById('view-' + viewId)
    if(targetView) {
      targetView.classList.add('active')
    }
    
    const navAction = document.getElementById('nav-action')
    if(navAction) {
      navAction.style.display = viewId === 'home' ? 'none' : 'block'
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }

  // Comprehensive Net Sheet Calculations
  const calcTotalDeductions = () => {
    const comm = netData.salePrice * (netData.agentCommissionPct / 100)
    const transfer = netData.salePrice * (netData.transferTaxPct / 100)
    return (
      Number(netData.mortgagePayoff) +
      Number(netData.secondMortgage) +
      Number(netData.propertyTaxesOwed) +
      Number(netData.hoaFeesDue) +
      comm +
      transfer +
      Number(netData.titleEscrowFee) +
      Number(netData.attorneyFee) +
      Number(netData.homeWarranty) +
      Number(netData.repairsCredit)
    )
  }

  const calculatedNetProceeds = netData.salePrice - calcTotalDeductions()

  const handleNetInputChange = (field, val) => {
    setNetData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: parseFloat(val) || 0 }))
  }

  const submitOpenHouse = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  const resetOpenHouse = () => {
    document.getElementById('oh-name').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-phone').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  const handleStep1Submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    if (!user) {
      const { error: authError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({
        email: profile.email,
        options: { 
          shouldCreateUser: true,
          emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin
        }
      })

      if (authError) {
        showCustomModal('Error sending verification link: ' + authError.message)
        return
      }

      showCustomModal('Magic link sent! Check your email to verify your account and proceed to Step 2.')
      return
    }

    const updates = {
      id: user.id,
      full_name: profile.full_name,
      email: profile.email,
      phone: profile.phone,
      brokerage: profile.brokerage,
      pdf_look: profile.pdf_look,
      updated_at: new Date(),
    }

    const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').upsert(updates)

    if (error) {
      showCustomModal('Error saving profile: ' + error.message)
    } else {
      setProfileStep(2)
      showCustomModal('Basic info saved! Now add your images.')
    }
  }

  const handleImageUpload = async (e, fieldName) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0]
    if (!file || !user) return

    const maxSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024
    if (file.size > maxSize) {
      showCustomModal('File size is too large. Please upload an image under 5MB.')
      return
    }

    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      showCustomModal('Invalid file type. Please upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.')
      return
    }

    setUploading(true)
    const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop()
    const fileName = `${user.id}/${fieldName}-${Math.random()}.${fileExt}`

    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
      .from('profiles')
      .upload(fileName, file, { upsert: true })

    if (uploadError) {
      showCustomModal('Upload failed: ' + uploadError.message)
      setUploading(false)
      return
    }

    const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage
      .from('profiles')
      .getPublicUrl(fileName)

    const updatedProfile = { ...profile, [fieldName]: publicUrl }
    setProfile(updatedProfile)

    await supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
      id: user.id,
      [fieldName]: publicUrl,
      updated_at: new Date()
    })

    setUploading(false)
    showCustomModal('Image uploaded successfully!')
  }

  const savePdfLookSelection = async (lookKey) => {
    setProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, pdf_look: lookKey }))
    if (user) {
      await supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
        id: user.id,
        pdf_look: lookKey,
        updated_at: new Date()
      })
    }
  }

  // Renders Agent Header Look based on selected profile design style
  const renderAgentHeader = (themeOverride = null) => {
    const look = themeOverride || profile.pdf_look || 'modern'
    const name = profile.full_name || 'Jane Doe'
    const brokerage = profile.brokerage || 'Luxury Real Estate Inc.'
    const phone = profile.phone || '(555) 123-4567'
    const headshot = profile.headshot_url
    const logo = profile.logo_url

    switch(look) {
      case 'minimalist':
        return (
          <div className="border-b border-slate-200 pb-4 mb-4 flex justify-between items-center text-slate-800">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base tracking-tight">{name}</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest">{brokerage} • {phone}</p>
            </div>
            {headshot && <img src={headshot} alt="Headshot" className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover grayscale" />}
          </div>
        )
      case 'luxury':
        return (
          <div className="bg-slate-900 text-amber-100 p-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-400 font-semibold">Exclusive Presentation</span>
              <h3 className="font-serif text-lg tracking-wide">{name}</h3>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-300">{brokerage} | {phone}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {headshot && <img src={headshot} alt="Headshot" className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full object-cover border border-amber-400" />}
              {logo && <img src={logo} alt="Logo" className="w-9 h-9 object-contain" />}
            </div>
          </div>
        )
      case 'bold':
        return (
          <div className="bg-emerald-600 text-white p-4 rounded-xl flex justify-between items-center mb-5 shadow-md">
            <div>
              <span className="bg-black/20 text-[9px] uppercase font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded">Verified Agent</span>
              <h3 className="text-xl font-black mt-1 tracking-tight">{name}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-emerald-100 font-medium">{phone} • {brokerage}</p>
            </div>
            {headshot && <img src={headshot} alt="Headshot" className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover border-2 border-white" />}
          </div>
        )
      case 'corporate':
        return (
          <div className="bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 p-4 rounded-lg flex justify-between items-center mb-5 text-slate-900">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              {logo && <img src={logo} alt="Logo" className="w-10 h-10 object-contain bg-white p-1 rounded border border-slate-200" />}
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm">{name}</h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600">{brokerage} | {phone}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            {headshot && <img src={headshot} alt="Headshot" className="w-10 h-10 rounded object-cover" />}
          </div>
        )
      case 'modern':
      default:
        return (
          <div className="border-b border-slate-200 pb-4 mb-4 flex justify-between items-center">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-600 font-seller">Prepared By</span>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">{name}</h2>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">{phone} • {brokerage}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {headshot && <img src={headshot} alt="Headshot" className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover border border-slate-200" />}
              {logo && <img src={logo} alt="Logo" className="w-8 h-8 object-contain" />}
            </div>
          </div>
        )
    }
  }

  return (

// Reusable Email Magic Link Login Widget
function EmailLoginWidget() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')

  const handleSendMagicLink = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setMessage('')
    
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({ 
      email,
      options: { 
        shouldCreateUser: true,
        emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin
      }
    })

    if (error) {
      setMessage(error.message)
    } else {
      setSent(true)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-2xl max-w-md mx-auto">
      {!sent ? (
        <form onSubmit={handleSendMagicLink} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block mb-1">Email Address</label>
            <input 
              type="email"
              placeholder="name@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
            />
          </div>
          <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black py-4 rounded-xl transition shadow-lg">
            Send Magic Link →
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-center space-y-3 py-4">
          <div className="text-4xl mb-2">✨</div>
          <h3 className="font-money text-3xl text-emerald-400 tracking-wide">Magic Link Sent!</h3>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">Check your email inbox and click the link to log straight in.</p>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            onClick={() => { setSent(false); setEmail(''); setMessage(''); }}
            className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-white underline pt-4 block mx-auto"
          >
            Use a different email
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {message && !sent && (
        <p className="text-xs text-center font-medium mt-4 text-rose-400">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
The headers are not saving to the database. Also, let's really make them beautiful. The current ones feel a bit generic.

To make sure the PDF look preference is saved to your database, we first need to add the pdf_look column to your Supabase profiles table.

Run this quick SQL query in your Supabase SQL Editor:

SQL
alter table public.profiles add column if not exists pdf_look text default 'modern';
The Updated app/page.jsx File
Below is the complete, updated file. I have redesigned the 5 PDF Agent Header looks to feel high-end, bespoke, and professional—completely moving away from generic boxes into striking, beautifully styled designs (featuring luxury typography, rich gradients, and elegant accents).

JavaScript
'use client'
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { supabase } from '@/utils/supabase'

export default function HomePage() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)
  const [profileStep, setProfileStep] = useState(1) 
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState({
    full_name: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    brokerage: '',
    headshot_url: '',
    logo_url: '',
    pdf_look: 'luxury'
  })
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false)

  // Comprehensive Net Sheet State
  const [netData, setNetData] = useState({
    salePrice: 750000,
    mortgagePayoff: 400000,
    secondMortgage: 0,
    propertyTaxesOwed: 2500,
    hoaFeesDue: 300,
    agentCommissionPct: 5,
    transferTaxPct: 0.75,
    titleEscrowFee: 1500,
    attorneyFee: 750,
    homeWarranty: 600,
    repairsCredit: 0
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
      const currentUser = session?.user || null
      setUser(currentUser)

      if (currentUser) {
        const { data } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', currentUser.id)
          .single()
        
        if (data) {
          setProfile({
            full_name: data.full_name || '',
            email: data.email || currentUser.email || '',
            phone: data.phone || '',
            brokerage: data.brokerage || '',
            headshot_url: data.headshot_url || '',
            logo_url: data.logo_url || '',
            pdf_look: data.pdf_look || 'luxury'
          })
        } else {
          setProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, email: currentUser.email || '' }))
        }
      }
    }
    loadData()
    switchView('home')
  }, [])

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    window.location.reload()
  }

  const showCustomModal = (msg) => {
    const modalMsg = document.getElementById('modal-message')
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modalMsg && modal) {
      modalMsg.innerText = msg
      modal.classList.remove('hidden')
    }
  }

  const closeCustomModal = () => {
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-modal')
    if (modal) {
      modal.classList.add('hidden')
    }
  }

  const switchView = (viewId) => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.app-view').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('active')
    })
    
    const targetView = document.getElementById('view-' + viewId)
    if(targetView) {
      targetView.classList.add('active')
    }
    
    const navAction = document.getElementById('nav-action')
    if(navAction) {
      navAction.style.display = viewId === 'home' ? 'none' : 'block'
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }

  const calcTotalDeductions = () => {
    const comm = netData.salePrice * (netData.agentCommissionPct / 100)
    const transfer = netData.salePrice * (netData.transferTaxPct / 100)
    return (
      Number(netData.mortgagePayoff) +
      Number(netData.secondMortgage) +
      Number(netData.propertyTaxesOwed) +
      Number(netData.hoaFeesDue) +
      comm +
      transfer +
      Number(netData.titleEscrowFee) +
      Number(netData.attorneyFee) +
      Number(netData.homeWarranty) +
      Number(netData.repairsCredit)
    )
  }

  const calculatedNetProceeds = netData.salePrice - calcTotalDeductions()

  const handleNetInputChange = (field, val) => {
    setNetData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: parseFloat(val) || 0 }))
  }

  const submitOpenHouse = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  const resetOpenHouse = () => {
    document.getElementById('oh-name').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-phone').value = ''
    document.getElementById('oh-success').classList.add('hidden')
    document.getElementById('oh-form-container').classList.remove('hidden')
  }

  const handleStep1Submit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    if (!user) {
      const { error: authError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({
        email: profile.email,
        options: { 
          shouldCreateUser: true,
          emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin
        }
      })

      if (authError) {
        showCustomModal('Error sending verification link: ' + authError.message)
        return
      }

      showCustomModal('Magic link sent! Check your email to verify your account and proceed to Step 2.')
      return
    }

    const updates = {
      id: user.id,
      full_name: profile.full_name,
      email: profile.email,
      phone: profile.phone,
      brokerage: profile.brokerage,
      pdf_look: profile.pdf_look,
      updated_at: new Date(),
    }

    const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').upsert(updates)

    if (error) {
      showCustomModal('Error saving profile: ' + error.message)
    } else {
      setProfileStep(2)
      showCustomModal('Basic info & PDF style saved! Now add your images.')
    }
  }

  const handleImageUpload = async (e, fieldName) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0]
    if (!file || !user) return

    const maxSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024
    if (file.size > maxSize) {
      showCustomModal('File size is too large. Please upload an image under 5MB.')
      return
    }

    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      showCustomModal('Invalid file type. Please upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.')
      return
    }

    setUploading(true)
    const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop()
    const fileName = `${user.id}/${fieldName}-${Math.random()}.${fileExt}`

    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
      .from('profiles')
      .upload(fileName, file, { upsert: true })

    if (uploadError) {
      showCustomModal('Upload failed: ' + uploadError.message)
      setUploading(false)
      return
    }

    const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage
      .from('profiles')
      .getPublicUrl(fileName)

    const updatedProfile = { ...profile, [fieldName]: publicUrl }
    setProfile(updatedProfile)

    await supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
      id: user.id,
      [fieldName]: publicUrl,
      updated_at: new Date()
    })

    setUploading(false)
    showCustomModal('Image uploaded successfully!')
  }

  const savePdfLookSelection = async (lookKey) => {
    setProfile(prev => ({ ...prev, pdf_look: lookKey }))
    if (user) {
      await supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
        id: user.id,
        pdf_look: lookKey,
        updated_at: new Date()
      })
    }
  }

  // 5 Beautiful, Bespoke Agent Header Designs for PDFs and Previews
  const renderAgentHeader = (themeOverride = null) => {
    const look = themeOverride || profile.pdf_look || 'luxury'
    const name = profile.full_name || 'Jane Doe'
    const brokerage = profile.brokerage || 'Luxury Real Estate Inc.'
    const phone = profile.phone || '(555) 123-4567'
    const headshot = profile.headshot_url
    const logo = profile.logo_url

    switch(look) {
      case 'editorial': // Look 2: High-Fashion Editorial Monotone
        return (
          <div className="border-t-2 border-b-2 border-slate-900 py-4 mb-5 flex justify-between items-center text-slate-900 bg-white px-2">
            <div>
